Shameless Family

By: Sophia Phirippides | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
You're a proud homeowner and want to renovate, what do you do when your builder goes rogue? Carte Blanche exposes a shameless family of builders that has left many homeowners knee deep in rubble.

Unique Selling Point:
Jan Buitendag, his wife Sharon Janse Van Rensburg, and her Son Marko are scam builders, with a variety of companies purporting to do various aspects of renovation or building. They ask for 80% of the cost of the job up front and an additional on site fee for the first day, and in many instances never complete the job or return the money to the client. Carte Blanche investigates and exposes this shameless family.

Summary:
Jan Buitendag, his wife Sharon Janse Van Rensburg and her son Marko are in the building and renovation business, but their main line of business is to scam their clients out of their 80% deposit for a job as well as the on-site fee. Jan who is an ex-policeman has fallen foul of the law before, where he was involved in a second car sales scam and ended up with a three year prison sentence. Back on the loose he continues to rip off trusting customers who want to renovate or do alterations to their homes and businesses. They operate under a number of companies with different names. Once the client parts with their money Jan and his crew are no-where to be found. If the client manages to get them on the phone to ask for their money or when the job will get completed, they attack the client verbally and tell them to stop harassing them, they even use the excuse that Sharon, Jan's wife is very ill. Many customers have laid charges with the police, but nothing seems to be done about them, and they continue going about their business scamming new clients. Carte Blanche investigates this shameless family and speaks to the helpless homeowners who are out of pocket and who either have paid someone else again to do the job, or simply can't afford to get someone else in and have to settle with the mess that Jan has left them in.

Further information:
Victim No1. Is Verashna Singh who wanted to renovate the back rooms of her house, so that she could turn them into rental units. Jan quoted her a total of R38 000 to do the job. She had to pay R31 000 rand up front and an on site fee of R3 500 He and his son Marko arrived in April 2018, removed the roof, created a whole lot of rubble and left the site, not to come back for a while, then they came back to the site and Verashna's brother was there where he recorded the meeting between them and Jan and he agreed to have the rooms ready for Mother's Day. After that they never saw them again, they made repeated phone calls, where they were told that Sharon was very ill. When they left it and tried again at a later time, they were told to stop harassing them. Verashna tried to open a case with the police but was told they could do nothing as she had paid the money over to Jan. To this day she is still sitting with the mess as she can't afford another builder.

Vivek Singh, Tania's brother, has dealt with Jan first-hand, but also has done renovations of his own, learning from his sister's experience he says that with his alterations, he sat and watched and bought every item the builders required himself, and when they finished one section, he would move onto the next. He believes it's the only way to keep builders honest, by not giving them a square inch of leeway.

Victim No 2: Tania De Beer. She paid over R35 000 rand to Jan and had to bring on other builders to complete the job they never finished. She has been threatened by the son Marko and is afraid of them.

There are many people in a Whatsapp group that have similar stories and some have laid charges with the police, but still this family is in business.

Jo-Anne and Corne De Beer used to work for Jan and Sharon in 2017/2018, and have the inside take on how the scam operated. Corne is actually a cousin of Jan, and was offered a job by them when he was struggling to find a job. He became their site manager, while his wife Jo-Anne worked in the office. Corne describes how he would go on site to start a job, and then get a phone call from either Jan or Sharon to tell him to leave the site immediately as the client had not paid the money, later he would find out from his wife Jo-Anne that the money from the clients had been paid. He describes how once a client was so angry as the materials supplied on site were not the ones quoted for that he removed Corne's keys from his bakkie and kept them on his site. Jo-Anne describes how irate clients would call all the time for the jobs to be completed or for their money to be returned and Sharon would fob them onto her and make her deal with the queries.

Jan even accused Corne of stealing materials, which he says was impossible as he used the company bakkie and had to deliver the materials back to their premises. Fed up they both left the company, but now Corne says he has struggled to get a job as he has been associated with Jan. Currently he is working and has found a job. Jo-Anne is still battling to find one. They did try to lay a complaint with the CCMA, but as they had no employment contract the CCMA could not help them. Both of them have outstanding salaries from Jan and Sharon. They are afraid of Jan and Sharon, as Marko has threatened to harm their children in the past.

We confront Jan and Sharon and demand that they give us some answers, and can we recover some of the victim's money?

Case Study:
Verashna Singh
Vivek Singh
Tania De Beer
Jo-Anne and Corne De Beer
Jan Buitendag
Sharon Janse Van Rensburg

Press Release:


Construction Conundrum
For several years a family-owned construction company now operating from the West Rand has been taking on renovation jobs, demanding 80% deposits and on-site fees for the first day of work… and then disappearing with their clients’ money. Phone calls, emails and letters of demand have gone unanswered. Together with several irate property owners who have been left knee-deep in rubble and thousands of Rands out of pocket, Carte Blanche tracks down the family and confronts them on their modus operandi.
Producer: Sophia Phirippides
Presenter: Macfarlane Moleli


Script:


LINK: Mac: Property ownership is everyone's dream but for you to have that picture perfect building or home you may need to renovate here and refurbish there so what do you do when the person you've trusted with your dream goes rogue?

VO: Verashna Singh, a single mother, wanted to create additional income by expanding her Day Spa at her home in Roodepoort, before Mother’s day in 2018. She found a builder online.

Verashna: I tried to review their business and their comments, I was very trusting at that time.

VO: The company was called Hyzter Roofing, Sharon Janse Van Rensburg CEO, Jan Buitendag - Sales and Sharon’s son Marko - on-site manager. Jan Buitendag came to Verashna’s home to give her a quote, which she accepted.

Verashna: The entire job would have cost me 30 500

Mac: You paid the full amount?

Verashna: Yes.

VO: In March last year Johan and Tania De Beer, needed a roof for a flatlet they had built for their parents, they paid Hyzter Roofing a deposit of R31 500 and an on site cash payment of R3 500.

Tania: And then they came for a few days with a few pieces of wood and the guys that was here they didn’t even know what they were doing with the roof.

Johan: So I started to help them. I phoned Marko, Marko denied it, he said no it will go better tomorrow when he is on site - so they never came back the following day.

VO: Marko, Jan’s stepson, was in charge of on site management for Hyzter Roofing at the time.

Verashna: His workers were here, nothing, the rubble is still here, they were sitting on my porch swing and i asked them what’s going on. We got no cement, we got no stones, we waiting for Marko.
Mac: But they pitched up but they weren’t doing the work?

Verashna: It was excuses with the mom being ill, they're rushing her to hospital.

Mac: Did you try to say i want my money back?

Verashna: Yes plenty times.

Mac: And what was the response?

Verashna: We can come back and finish your job. They just never came back.

Johan: I kept on phoning them, went to their house, asked what’s going on, no as soon as we are finished we're just quite busy and a week after that now Sharron is sick. She's the CEO and they can't do nothing without her.

VO: After getting no response, Johan and Tania did more research.

Tania: We found out that they actually scamming people, there was comments on Hello Peter, all over Facebook on the business they advertising that’s when i started to think this people is real scammers.

VO: Johan opened a police case, as did others, using their records of shoddy workmanship and inferior materials as evidence, like this paper thin IBR sheeting provided for a Carport. But how did Sharon, Jan and Marko manage to get away with it?

Corne: We started noticing something is not right, customers phoning us and asking where their material is, wrong material issues to sites, getting to site being pulled off because the person didn’t make the first on site payment.

VO: Corne De Beer, a cousin of Sharon Janse Van Rensburg, and his wife Dominique, worked for Sharon and Jan, for just a few months during 2017 and 18.

Corne: Jan came into the family a really long time ago. When i first met him he was an ex policeman.

VO: Corne was employed as a site manager and Dominique was hired to do sales. They say they are still waiting for some outstanding salary cheques.


Domenique: The first customer that I had to personally work ordered a pergola from us. He was upset because the guys were supposed to go out to his side that day and Sharon told me phone him and tell him we can’t go out to his side today due to weather and i told her but there is no weather, it’s gonna be sunshine all day they never finished his job.

VO: General Manager of the Lakeview Boutique Hotel in Benoni, Peter Roux also ordered a very large pergola from them.

Peter: It must be the biggest crooks i've ever met in my entire life. Promises that was never kept, money that was demanded in advance, nothing gets delivered.

VO: This is the Pergola that Hyzter roofing was supposed to erect, Peter paid a R42700 deposit as well as a R6000, on site fee.

Peter: Wood specs was never the right ones that was quoted for, they put inferior wood on the pergola it was just crazy.

Corne: When the customer saw it he said this is not what i paid for, this is not what i ordered

Peter: I said this is not on. Call your boss, bring him here, until then i've got the car keys. Never came.

Corne: And that’s when i handed in my resignation letter and I said to them listen here i’m done i can’t do this anymore

Peter: Eventually they started screaming at me and swearing at me because I kept on phoning and demanding them to finish.

Mac: And who were you speaking to?

Peter: To the wife, i spoke to her on the phone and she was very rude. we are not crooks, we don’t steal peoples money but they did steal my money, lots of money so ya.

Corne: Hyzter Roofing was just one of the fronts, they had numerous companies doing the same job like Hyper roofing, Pergola Depot but it’s part of one scam.

VO: They traded under various companies all riddled with similar complaints. But often payments were made into Sharon’s brother’s bank account.

Domenique: Quinton is Sharron's down syndrome brother they use his name for everything that is where i picked up Jan is mostly involved with when they have to speak to the bank or go with the bank then Jan is the one going in.

LINK: We're outside Jan Buitendag's house, we're trying to get a hold of him. All the numbers that we've tried go straight to voicemail.

Mac: Hello is there anybody home?

Mac: Hi its Macfarlane from Carte Blanche we're looking for Jan Buitendag.

Mac: Hello we're looking for Mr Jan Buitendag

Marko: He's not here.

Mac: is he not here

Marko: no

Mac: is that not you Marko?

Mac: Is it possible that we can speak to you guys please

Marko: Nobody's here buddy.

Mac: We're looking for Jan or Marko please

Marko: Hulle is nie hier nie. Hulle het getrek
They are not here, they’ve moved.

Mac: Isn’t it you thats involved with your dad in this business?

Marko: Nee jy is mal. is nie ek nie.
No, you’re mad, it’s not me.

Marko: So my videotape van die, kry jou pakgee
If you videotape me, I’m going to give you a hiding.

Marko: My naam is Martin.
My name is Martin.


VO: Martin or Marko, took us into the house to show us that Jan and Sharon weren’t there

Sound Up: Marko no cameras : As jy die camera verby trek ek wil by jou gat optrek.
If you enter with that camera I’m going to shove it up your a**.

VO: Waiting at the gate were some angry clients who came with us this morning … they want their money back.

Mac: Is this Marko?

Verashna: 100 percent Marko

Mac: We've got a picture of you here that these people say you're the one that’s Marko

Marko: Die is ek, ja
That’s me, yes.

Johan: Maar wie is jy?
So who are you?

Marko: Ek het gese wie ek is.
I told you who I am.

Johan: Wie is jy?
Who are you?

Marko: Moenie kom kak vir my huis nie.
Don’t come and cause sh*** at my house

Johan: Wie is Jy? Jy is Marko
Who are you? You are Marko.

Marko: Moenie kom kak vir my huis nie want hulle kom en provoke my ne en hulle is op my teritoriteit, hy kan vir my niks doen nie.
Don’t come and cause sh*** at my house. He’s just provoking me now. He’s on my territory, he can do nothing to me.

Johan: En die kere wat julle ons prokoke het? Wat gaan jy doen?
And the times you provoked us? What are you going to do?

Marko: ..asseblief
Please!

Johan: Wat gaan jy doen
What are you going to do?

Marko: Jy sien nou wat hy doen?
Can you see what he’s doing?

Sophia: Johan step back

VO: Temperatures rose at the scene

Producer: You said you were Martin, but why did you lie?

Marko: Boeta bring gou my skoene
Boeta bring my shoes quickly.

Producer: Why did you lie

Girl: Gee my my vokken foon.
Give me my f***ng phone.

Marko: Jy sien, she broke the phone, are you serious now

Girl: You fucking put that thing in my face

Producer: Are you speaking to me

Girl: Yes I am, you don’t fucking grab my stuff do you hear me?

Marko: Kry die vokken vrou van my driveway af.
Remove this woman off my driveway.

Producer: Marko she stuck the phone in my face

Marko: You broke it man

Girl: Hierdie vokken ding maak alles erger
This f***ng thing is making everything worse.

Marko: As hierdie vrou haar pa bel gaan hulle dinner as parafin pis
If this woman calls her father, you will be pissing thinner than paraffin.

VO: And then a modicum of calm was restored

Johan: Okay maar nou gee my R3500 wat ek het in jou hande gegee
Give me back the R3500 that I gave you in your hands.

Marko: Dis toe ek het hulle gewerk
That’s when I worked for them.

Johan: Ek het in jou hande gegee
I put it in your hands.

Marko: Wat bedoel jy, jy gee dit mos vir die company.
What do you mean, you gave it for the company.


VO: Finally Marko agreed to contact Sharon and Jan and ask them to talk to us. He said he was just an employee.

Mac: Did you know that they were scamming people

Marko: Nee
No.

Mac: So you always thought you were coming back to do the work but it never happened

Marko: By the 5th day by Mrs Verashna's side buy the 5th day when her brother phoned me i said i don’t know what to tell you anymore there's no money for me to work so what must i do.

Verashna: Then you shouldn’t have taken my job Marko,it’s as simple as that my building is still standing as it is

Marko: Ja but you know I tried to help you

Verashna: No you didn’t

Marko: I did

Verashna: You didn’t, you were rude, you didn’t even come and remove my rubble from my yard.

Mac: Look at what they’ve done i mean this is not fair nobody would be happy with this and thats

Verashna: I'm a single mother it took me 4 years to save my money to do my building .

VO: Collectively just these people today were owed
R100 000 rand.

Marko: I will help as far as I can.

VO: Marko claimed that his very ill mother was innocent and that Jan was the culprit in all of this.

Marko: He’s the big problem, its not my mother hes the problem. He’s a fucked up skelm ek wil vokol vir hom weet. Ek se did, ek wil niks vir hom weet nie.

He’s a f****d up crook, I don’t want to have anything to do with him. I’m saying, I want nothing to do with him.

Mac: But he’s scamming people this is very serious look at all of these poor people.

Marko: I know but it is nie ek nie verstaan jy, so jy kan nie my blame vir dit nie

I Know, but it’s not me, understand? You can’t blame me for it.

Mac: But let’s try get ahold of him please


Marko: Ek sal

Marko: Ek het die oom gese ek sal voor die dag uit is.

I told the guy, that I will do it before the end of the day.

VO: And then we waited ….


LINK: (phone ringing) (voicemail) well there we go again, we've been trying to get ahold of Sharon and once again we called, she doesn’t answer our calls.

Mac: Hello…

Mac: So we’re trying to get hold of sharon,.. but voicemail

Ring ring.. You have reached

Mac: It’s not going to happen …

you have reached 081

Mac: Hi Sharon how you?

Sharon: Well and yourself?

VO: Finally Sharon called and said she would meet us in the presence of her attorney

VO: But the next phone call went like this

Mac: So you're not going t talk to us anymore

Sharon: No unfortunately not.

VO: Sharon and Jan referred us to their attorney for their Right of Reply. We sent a detailed email with all the allegations. The attorney’s response states: that a criminal case currently pending, related to Carte Blanche’s investigations, makes the matter sub judice and as a result he gives “no comment”.

VO: But for devastated clients the collateral damage remains.

Johan: We went to the bank and make a loan to pay them that money and ever since they take us for a scam i had to get someone else to do it so they a bt more expensive i had to sell my bakkie to do it so i'm very angry.

Tania: And not even just our money we want the whole South Africa to know who these people are so they don’t scam other people also.

Weitz, TRL062 TX Details Back references from Insert in Show: Title Author Last Updated 10 February 2019 - Carte Blanche HD nombuso@carteblanche.co.za 15 March 2019 Press Release: Construction Conundrum For several years a family-owned construction company now operating from the West Rand has been taking on renovation jobs, demanding 80% deposits and on-site fees for the first day of work… and then disappearing with their clients’ money. Phone calls, emails and letters of demand have gone unanswered. Together with several irate property owners who have been left knee-deep in rubble and thousands of Rands out of pocket, Carte Blanche tracks down the family and confronts them on their modus operandi. Producer: Sophia Phirippides Presenter: Macfarlane Moleli Script: LINK: Mac: Property ownership is everyone's dream but for you to have that picture perfect building or home you may need to renovate here and refurbish there so what do you do when the person you've trusted with your dream goes rogue? VO: Verashna Singh, a single mother, wanted to create additional income by expanding her Day Spa at her home in Roodepoort, before Mother’s day in 2018. She found a builder online. Verashna: I tried to review their business and their comments, I was very trusting at that time. VO: The company was called Hyzter Roofing, Sharon Janse Van Rensburg CEO, Jan Buitendag - Sales and Sharon’s son Marko - on-site manager. Jan Buitendag came to Verashna’s home to give her a quote, which she accepted. Verashna: The entire job would have cost me 30 500 Mac: You paid the full amount? Verashna: Yes. VO: In March last year Johan and Tania De Beer, needed a roof for a flatlet they had built for their parents, they paid Hyzter Roofing a deposit of R31 500 and an on site cash payment of R3 500. Tania: And then they came for a few days with a few pieces of wood and the guys that was here they didn’t even know what they were doing with the roof. Johan: So I started to help them. I phoned Marko, Marko denied it, he said no it will go better tomorrow when he is on site - so they never came back the following day. VO: Marko, Jan’s stepson, was in charge of on site management for Hyzter Roofing at the time. Verashna: His workers were here, nothing, the rubble is still here, they were sitting on my porch swing and i asked them what’s going on. We got no cement, we got no stones, we waiting for Marko. Mac: But they pitched up but they weren’t doing the work? Verashna: It was excuses with the mom being ill, they're rushing her to hospital. Mac: Did you try to say i want my money back? Verashna: Yes plenty times. Mac: And what was the response? Verashna: We can come back and finish your job. They just never came back. Johan: I kept on phoning them, went to their house, asked what’s going on, no as soon as we are finished we're just quite busy and a week after that now Sharron is sick. She's the CEO and they can't do nothing without her. VO: After getting no response, Johan and Tania did more research. Tania: We found out that they actually scamming people, there was comments on Hello Peter, all over Facebook on the business they advertising that’s when i started to think this people is real scammers. VO: Johan opened a police case, as did others, using their records of shoddy workmanship and inferior materials as evidence, like this paper thin IBR sheeting provided for a Carport. But how did Sharon, Jan and Marko manage to get away with it? Corne: We started noticing something is not right, customers phoning us and asking where their material is, wrong material issues to sites, getting to site being pulled off because the person didn’t make the first on site payment. VO: Corne De Beer, a cousin of Sharon Janse Van Rensburg, and his wife Dominique, worked for Sharon and Jan, for just a few months during 2017 and 18. Corne: Jan came into the family a really long time ago. When i first met him he was an ex policeman. VO: Corne was employed as a site manager and Dominique was hired to do sales. They say they are still waiting for some outstanding salary cheques. Domenique: The first customer that I had to personally work ordered a pergola from us. He was upset because the guys were supposed to go out to his side that day and Sharon told me phone him and tell him we can’t go out to his side today due to weather and i told her but there is no weather, it’s gonna be sunshine all day they never finished his job. VO: General Manager of the Lakeview Boutique Hotel in Benoni, Peter Roux also ordered a very large pergola from them. Peter: It must be the biggest crooks i've ever met in my entire life. Promises that was never kept, money that was demanded in advance, nothing gets delivered. VO: This is the Pergola that Hyzter roofing was supposed to erect, Peter paid a R42700 deposit as well as a R6000, on site fee. Peter: Wood specs was never the right ones that was quoted for, they put inferior wood on the pergola it was just crazy. Corne: When the customer saw it he said this is not what i paid for, this is not what i ordered Peter: I said this is not on. Call your boss, bring him here, until then i've got the car keys. Never came. Corne: And that’s when i handed in my resignation letter and I said to them listen here i’m done i can’t do this anymore Peter: Eventually they started screaming at me and swearing at me because I kept on phoning and demanding them to finish. Mac: And who were you speaking to? Peter: To the wife, i spoke to her on the phone and she was very rude. we are not crooks, we don’t steal peoples money but they did steal my money, lots of money so ya. Corne: Hyzter Roofing was just one of the fronts, they had numerous companies doing the same job like Hyper roofing, Pergola Depot but it’s part of one scam. VO: They traded under various companies all riddled with similar complaints. But often payments were made into Sharon’s brother’s bank account. Domenique: Quinton is Sharron's down syndrome brother they use his name for everything that is where i picked up Jan is mostly involved with when they have to speak to the bank or go with the bank then Jan is the one going in. LINK: We're outside Jan Buitendag's house, we're trying to get a hold of him. All the numbers that we've tried go straight to voicemail. Mac: Hello is there anybody home? Mac: Hi its Macfarlane from Carte Blanche we're looking for Jan Buitendag. Mac: Hello we're looking for Mr Jan Buitendag Marko: He's not here. Mac: is he not here Marko: no Mac: is that not you Marko? Mac: Is it possible that we can speak to you guys please Marko: Nobody's here buddy. Mac: We're looking for Jan or Marko please Marko: Hulle is nie hier nie. Hulle het getrek They are not here, they’ve moved. Mac: Isn’t it you thats involved with your dad in this business? Marko: Nee jy is mal. is nie ek nie. No, you’re mad, it’s not me. Marko: So my videotape van die, kry jou pakgee If you videotape me, I’m going to give you a hiding. Marko: My naam is Martin. My name is Martin. VO: Martin or Marko, took us into the house to show us that Jan and Sharon weren’t there Sound Up: Marko no cameras : As jy die camera verby trek ek wil by jou gat optrek. If you enter with that camera I’m going to shove it up your a**. VO: Waiting at the gate were some angry clients who came with us this morning … they want their money back. Mac: Is this Marko? Verashna: 100 percent Marko Mac: We've got a picture of you here that these people say you're the one that’s Marko Marko: Die is ek, ja That’s me, yes. Johan: Maar wie is jy? So who are you? Marko: Ek het gese wie ek is. I told you who I am. Johan: Wie is jy? Who are you? Marko: Moenie kom kak vir my huis nie. Don’t come and cause sh*** at my house Johan: Wie is Jy? Jy is Marko Who are you? You are Marko. Marko: Moenie kom kak vir my huis nie want hulle kom en provoke my ne en hulle is op my teritoriteit, hy kan vir my niks doen nie. Don’t come and cause sh*** at my house. He’s just provoking me now. He’s on my territory, he can do nothing to me. Johan: En die kere wat julle ons prokoke het? Wat gaan jy doen? And the times you provoked us? What are you going to do? Marko: ..asseblief Please! Johan: Wat gaan jy doen What are you going to do? Marko: Jy sien nou wat hy doen? Can you see what he’s doing? Sophia: Johan step back VO: Temperatures rose at the scene Producer: You said you were Martin, but why did you lie? Marko: Boeta bring gou my skoene Boeta bring my shoes quickly. Producer: Why did you lie Girl: Gee my my vokken foon. Give me my f***ng phone. Marko: Jy sien, she broke the phone, are you serious now Girl: You fucking put that thing in my face Producer: Are you speaking to me Girl: Yes I am, you don’t fucking grab my stuff do you hear me? Marko: Kry die vokken vrou van my driveway af. Remove this woman off my driveway. Producer: Marko she stuck the phone in my face Marko: You broke it man Girl: Hierdie vokken ding maak alles erger This f***ng thing is making everything worse. Marko: As hierdie vrou haar pa bel gaan hulle dinner as parafin pis If this woman calls her father, you will be pissing thinner than paraffin. VO: And then a modicum of calm was restored Johan: Okay maar nou gee my R3500 wat ek het in jou hande gegee Give me back the R3500 that I gave you in your hands. Marko: Dis toe ek het hulle gewerk That’s when I worked for them. Johan: Ek het in jou hande gegee I put it in your hands. Marko: Wat bedoel jy, jy gee dit mos vir die company. What do you mean, you gave it for the company. VO: Finally Marko agreed to contact Sharon and Jan and ask them to talk to us. He said he was just an employee. Mac: Did you know that they were scamming people Marko: Nee No. Mac: So you always thought you were coming back to do the work but it never happened Marko: By the 5th day by Mrs Verashna's side buy the 5th day when her brother phoned me i said i don’t know what to tell you anymore there's no money for me to work so what must i do. Verashna: Then you shouldn’t have taken my job Marko,it’s as simple as that my building is still standing as it is Marko: Ja but you know I tried to help you Verashna: No you didn’t Marko: I did Verashna: You didn’t, you were rude, you didn’t even come and remove my rubble from my yard. Mac: Look at what they’ve done i mean this is not fair nobody would be happy with this and thats Verashna: I'm a single mother it took me 4 years to save my money to do my building . VO: Collectively just these people today were owed R100 000 rand. Marko: I will help as far as I can. VO: Marko claimed that his very ill mother was innocent and that Jan was the culprit in all of this. Marko: He’s the big problem, its not my mother hes the problem. He’s a fucked up skelm ek wil vokol vir hom weet. Ek se did, ek wil niks vir hom weet nie. He’s a f****d up crook, I don’t want to have anything to do with him. I’m saying, I want nothing to do with him. Mac: But he’s scamming people this is very serious look at all of these poor people. Marko: I know but it is nie ek nie verstaan jy, so jy kan nie my blame vir dit nie I Know, but it’s not me, understand? You can’t blame me for it. Mac: But let’s try get ahold of him please Marko: Ek sal Marko: Ek het die oom gese ek sal voor die dag uit is. I told the guy, that I will do it before the end of the day. VO: And then we waited …. LINK: (phone ringing) (voicemail) well there we go again, we've been trying to get ahold of Sharon and once again we called, she doesn’t answer our calls. Mac: Hello… Mac: So we’re trying to get hold of sharon,.. but voicemail Ring ring.. You have reached Mac: It’s not going to happen … you have reached 081 Mac: Hi Sharon how you? Sharon: Well and yourself? VO: Finally Sharon called and said she would meet us in the presence of her attorney VO: But the next phone call went like this Mac: So you're not going t talk to us anymore Sharon: No unfortunately not. VO: Sharon and Jan referred us to their attorney for their Right of Reply. We sent a detailed email with all the allegations. The attorney’s response states: that a criminal case currently pending, related to Carte Blanche’s investigations, makes the matter sub judice and as a result he gives “no comment”. VO: But for devastated clients the collateral damage remains. Johan: We went to the bank and make a loan to pay them that money and ever since they take us for a scam i had to get someone else to do it so they a bt more expensive i had to sell my bakkie to do it so i'm very angry. Tania: And not even just our money we want the whole South Africa to know who these people are so they don’t scam other people also.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): You're a proud homeowner and want to renovate, what do you do when your builder goes rogue? Carte Blanche exposes a shameless family of builders that has left many homeowners knee deep in rubble.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Jan Buitendag, his wife Sharon Janse Van Rensburg, and her Son Marko are scam builders, with a variety of companies purporting to do various aspects of renovation or building. They ask for 80% of the cost of the job up front and an additional on site fee for the first day, and in many instances never complete the job or return the money to the client. Carte Blanche investigates and exposes this shameless family.
metadata.Summary: Jan Buitendag, his wife Sharon Janse Van Rensburg and her son Marko are in the building and renovation business, but their main line of business is to scam their clients out of their 80% deposit for a job as well as the on-site fee. Jan who is an ex-policeman has fallen foul of the law before, where he was involved in a second car sales scam and ended up with a three year prison sentence. Back on the loose he continues to rip off trusting customers who want to renovate or do alterations to their homes and businesses. They operate under a number of companies with different names. Once the client parts with their money Jan and his crew are no-where to be found. If the client manages to get them on the phone to ask for their money or when the job will get completed, they attack the client verbally and tell them to stop harassing them, they even use the excuse that Sharon, Jan's wife is very ill. Many customers have laid charges with the police, but nothing seems to be done about them, and they continue going about their business scamming new clients. Carte Blanche investigates this shameless family and speaks to the helpless homeowners who are out of pocket and who either have paid someone else again to do the job, or simply can't afford to get someone else in and have to settle with the mess that Jan has left them in.
metadata.Further information: Victim No1. Is Verashna Singh who wanted to renovate the back rooms of her house, so that she could turn them into rental units. Jan quoted her a total of R38 000 to do the job. She had to pay R31 000 rand up front and an on site fee of R3 500 He and his son Marko arrived in April 2018, removed the roof, created a whole lot of rubble and left the site, not to come back for a while, then they came back to the site and Verashna's brother was there where he recorded the meeting between them and Jan and he agreed to have the rooms ready for Mother's Day. After that they never saw them again, they made repeated phone calls, where they were told that Sharon was very ill. When they left it and tried again at a later time, they were told to stop harassing them. Verashna tried to open a case with the police but was told they could do nothing as she had paid the money over to Jan. To this day she is still sitting with the mess as she can't afford another builder. Vivek Singh, Tania's brother, has dealt with Jan first-hand, but also has done renovations of his own, learning from his sister's experience he says that with his alterations, he sat and watched and bought every item the builders required himself, and when they finished one section, he would move onto the next. He believes it's the only way to keep builders honest, by not giving them a square inch of leeway. Victim No 2: Tania De Beer. She paid over R35 000 rand to Jan and had to bring on other builders to complete the job they never finished. She has been threatened by the son Marko and is afraid of them. There are many people in a Whatsapp group that have similar stories and some have laid charges with the police, but still this family is in business. Jo-Anne and Corne De Beer used to work for Jan and Sharon in 2017/2018, and have the inside take on how the scam operated. Corne is actually a cousin of Jan, and was offered a job by them when he was struggling to find a job. He became their site manager, while his wife Jo-Anne worked in the office. Corne describes how he would go on site to start a job, and then get a phone call from either Jan or Sharon to tell him to leave the site immediately as the client had not paid the money, later he would find out from his wife Jo-Anne that the money from the clients had been paid. He describes how once a client was so angry as the materials supplied on site were not the ones quoted for that he removed Corne's keys from his bakkie and kept them on his site. Jo-Anne describes how irate clients would call all the time for the jobs to be completed or for their money to be returned and Sharon would fob them onto her and make her deal with the queries. Jan even accused Corne of stealing materials, which he says was impossible as he used the company bakkie and had to deliver the materials back to their premises. Fed up they both left the company, but now Corne says he has struggled to get a job as he has been associated with Jan. Currently he is working and has found a job. Jo-Anne is still battling to find one. They did try to lay a complaint with the CCMA, but as they had no employment contract the CCMA could not help them. Both of them have outstanding salaries from Jan and Sharon. They are afraid of Jan and Sharon, as Marko has threatened to harm their children in the past. We confront Jan and Sharon and demand that they give us some answers, and can we recover some of the victim's money?
